assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and the three KEY_AREA polygons are repository-provided provisional rough geometry inferred from public text and approximate area constraints.
assumptions.impact: All derived land use, buildings, roads, green space, public space, phasing, metrics, figures, PDFs, and HTML are intake-only conceptual evidence. They must be regenerated after official or cleared geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, rail conditions, heritage requirements, drainage, fire safety, and engineering constraints remain unavailable in the public package.
assumptions.impact: The package is reviewable as a provisional AI design intake with submitted conceptual layers only. It does not establish statutory planning controls, engineering feasibility, land rights, construction scale, investment, procurement, or approval.

assumptions.statement: Submitted diagrams, PDFs, HTML, and text use original authored content plus the disclosed public/cleared sources and licensed font/software references.
assumptions.impact: No third-party map, photograph, trademark, portrait, icon set, or remote asset is embedded. New materials require a source and license entry before inclusion.

assumptions.statement: Four gates, scenario cards, project cards, responsibility roles, regional interfaces, and annual event modules are conceptual operating proposals rather than confirmed organizations, activities, approvals, contracts, or budgets.
assumptions.impact: Any implementation must independently confirm responsible parties, user participation, legal basis, data protection, accessibility, permits, safety, costs, maintenance, and public accountability before progressing beyond a sandbox.
